messages:
Sam (AE): Quick transfer for TapMeeter — closing today but we still have two blockers: SSO not validated and on-prem connector package missing from their infra inventory. renewal flagged if not live by next billing. Can CS own onboarding and coordinate eng?
Rina (CSM): I can take primary for onboarding. Need cert + IdP metadata and a window for end-to-end SSO test. Also want a checklist for the private connector install (who runs it on their side?).
Nora (Sales Ops): FYI renewal window is 30 days. Finance can approve a conditional 15% retention credit if onboarding completes within 14 days of contract renewal date. That requires sign-off from Support Eng on connector readiness.
Diego (Support Eng): I can triage the connector on Mon/Tue. @Rina please drop the network CIDR and whether they'll allow outbound on 443. Also need the connector logs if they tried the package.
Rina (CSM): They said infra team will run install but lack terraform module. I'll ask for the runner contact and share the install guide.
Maya (Onboarding): I'll schedule a 1-hr enablement session for them after we get SSO green. Proposed slots: Tue 10am PT or Wed 2pm PT. Prefer Tue to align with Diego.
Sam (AE): Confirmed — target Tue 10am PT. Sam to loop infra contact: tara@tapmeeter.io.
Diego (Support Eng): Created internal ticket CS-4928 and a support-play doc. Will upload connector install snippet and minimal sanity-check script.
deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4928 created by Diego. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4928
Rina (CSM): To help Diego, here's the IdP metadata they sent (pasted):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://idp.tapmeeter.io\">...metadata xml...
```
Diego (Support Eng): Thanks — can you also paste the redirect URI we should expect? I want to pre-populate the connector config.
Rina (CSM): Redirect: https://tapmeeter.io/_redwood/sso/callback
Diego (Support Eng): Perfect. I'll add that to the playbook. Next steps list: 1) Rina get cert + infra contact & connector logs by EOD today, 2) Diego preps connector package + sanity script by Mon EOD, 3) Maya schedules enablement Tue 10am PT, 4) Sam confirms renewal credit prerequisites with Nora and updates customer.
Sam (AE): I'll confirm the credit conditions and update the customer by EOD. Heads-up: customer feedback from trial — response latency spikes on long prompts; they flagged cost concerns. Put that on the follow-up agenda in enablement.
Maya (Onboarding): Will include an agenda item: SSO, connector install, perf baseline + cost controls (batching/quantization options).
Nora (Sales Ops): If perf issues persist after onboarding, we can open a dedicated pilot pricing discussion — log that as a renewal risk mitigation path.
Rina (CSM): Noted. I'll capture feedback and add to the success plan doc.
Diego (Support Eng): One quick check — please run this curl against their callback URL and paste response headers if possible: 
```
curl -I -X GET 'https://tapmeeter.io/_redwood/sso/callback' --resolve 'tapmeeter.io:443:203.0.113.12'
```
Rina (CSM): Will run it and share.
Sam (AE): Thanks all. If anything blocks the Tue slot, we escalate to Emily (Head of CS) and mark renewal as high risk.
Rina (CSM): Acknowledged.
Maya (Onboarding): I'll send the calendar invite once Diego confirms the playbook is uploaded. :calendar:
thread_summary: Sales to CS transfer for TapMeeter: SSO + on-prem connector blockers, renewal credit option, owners assigned (Rina=M, Diego=Eng, Maya=Enablement, Sam=AE, Nora=SalesOps). Plan for Tue 10am PT test + enablement. Ticket CS-4928 created.
